label: Marriott Bonvoy
short_description: From Ritz-Carlton's flagship suites to Courtyard's dependable business stays.
intro: Marriott Bonvoy is Marriott International's loyalty program, spanning roughly 30 hotel brands from ultra-luxury (The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W Hotels) through premium (JW Marriott, Marriott Hotels, Westin, Sheraton) to select-service and longer-stay options (Courtyard, Four Points, Fairfield). Elite status tiers -- Silver, Gold, Platinum, Titanium, and Ambassador -- unlock benefits like room upgrades, lounge access, and free breakfast, but exactly which perks a given hotel actually delivers varies a lot by property and brand tier. This directory tracks that property-by-property reality rather than the program's general terms.

faqs.question: Does every Marriott Bonvoy hotel offer the same elite benefits?
faqs.answer: No -- elite benefits like lounge access, breakfast, and upgrade likelihood vary significantly by hotel and brand tier, even at the same status level. A Platinum member gets a stronger experience at a full-service Marriott Hotel or Westin than at a select-service Courtyard or Four Points, and each hotel profile here notes what that property specifically provides.

faqs.question: How are these Bonvoy hotel reviews put together?
faqs.answer: Each listing combines verified property facts (address, brand, elite benefit details) with synthesized commentary drawn from public guest reviews and reporting, refreshed on a regular schedule. Every page shows when it was last checked and how many sources informed it.
